notes: The DAAD fee of 8,200 EUR per semester is listed "for applicants from: all countries" but the programme's own page gives 8.600 €/Semester; the own-page fee is used. For deadlines, the DAAD page only mentions "the end of June", which is a general deadline for all applicants, not specifically the international/non-EU one; therefore it is used with the own-page quote "Bewerbungsfrist 30. Juni 2027" from the programme's own page. For a Moroccan applicant, the regular track (7 semesters, 3.5 years) is used; the CompactTrack is a separate study model in cooperation with companies. Tuition excludes the 100 EUR application fee, 600 EUR enrolment fee, and semester contribution (15 EUR student council + approx. 230 EUR semester ticket).

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, proof via placement test/interview

note.fr: Un test d'anglais (B2), un test de maths, des tests cognitifs et un entretien font partie de l'Online Assessment Centre obligatoire.
note.en: An English test (B2), a maths test, cognitive tests and an interview are part of the mandatory Online Assessment Centre.

evidence.quote: Successfully complete our Online Assessment Centre, which consists of: Maths test Cognitive tests English test Interview

note.fr: Un diplôme de fin d'études secondaires reconnu (Bac marocain ou équivalent) est requis ; les deux derniers bulletins suffisent pour postuler.
note.en: A recognised secondary school diploma (Moroccan Bac or equivalent) is required; the last two school reports suffice to apply.

evidence.quote: A completed secondary school diploma (e.g. German Abitur, Fachhochschulreife, IB, EB, or equivalent)

note.fr: Bac international : vérifier l'équivalence dans la base de données Anabin.
note.en: International school-leaving certificate: check equivalence in the Anabin database.

evidence.quote: Internationale Schulabschlüsse: Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit einem internationalen Schulabschluss finden weitere Informationen in der Anabin-Datenbank.
